run:
set -e
# 문장은 argv 한 칸으로 들어온다 ($1). 셸을 안 거치므로 따옴표가 있어도 안 갈린다.
text=$1
enc=""
for c in lame "$HOME/.local/bin/lame" /opt/homebrew/bin/lame /usr/local/bin/lame; do
  if p=$(command -v "$c" 2>/dev/null); then enc=$p; break; fi
done
[ -n "$enc" ] || { echo "mp3 encoder missing" >&2; exit 5; }
w=$(mktemp -t greet).wav
trap 'rm -f "$w"' EXIT
say -v Yuna --file-format=WAVE --data-format=LEI16@22050 -o "$w" "$text"
"$enc" --quiet -b 64 -m m "$w" "$OUT/greeting.mp3"
[ -s "$OUT/greeting.mp3" ] || { echo "empty output" >&2; exit 4; }
afinfo "$OUT/greeting.mp3" | sed -n '1,8p'

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$f = Join-Path $env:IN 'greeting.mp3';if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { Write-Output 'staged file missing'; exit 6 };$target = '__PIHOST__';$dev = '__PIDEV__';$dest = '/tmp/enode-greet-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8) + '.mp3';Write-Output ('target=' + $target + ' dev=' + $dev + ' dest=' + $dest);& scp -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new $f ($target + ':' + $dest);if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output ('scp failed rc=' + $LASTEXITCODE); exit $LASTEXITCODE };$remote = "amixer -c 1 sset PCM 100% unmute >/dev/null 2>&1; " +          "mpg123 -q -o alsa -a $dev '$dest'; rc=`$?; " +          "cat /proc/asound/card1/pcm0p/sub0/status | head -1; " +          "rm -f '$dest'; exit `$rc";& ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new $target $remote;$rc = $LASTEXITCODE;Write-Output ('mpg123 rc=' + $rc);exit $rc
